items.lead: - Artemis deals 15% increased Basic Attack Damage to gods and 30% to minions that are affected by Crowd Control

items.text: New: Artemis is able to detect nearby enemy gods in stealth grass.

items.lead: - Place a trap on the ground. Enemy gods that come in contact with it activate it, Rooting, Crippling, and repeatedly dealing Physical Damage over 3 seconds.

items.text: New: Added motion to the enemy version of the trap to make them easier to see

items.lead: - Greatly increase your Movement Speed and Attack Speed.

items.text: New: While the buff is active, gain a charge each time you hit an enemy god with a basic attack. After reaching 4 charges they are consumed, extending the duration of the buff by 3s.

items.detail: - Fire a volley at the target area dealing Physical Damage and Slowing enemies.
- Summon the great Calydonian Boar that charges the nearest enemy god.

items.text: Transgressor's Fate no longer roots or cripples gods but can now target minions. Triggered traps now also heal Artemis and deal damage to enemies in a larger area.

items.lead: - If you have not taken or dealt damage in the last 5 seconds, gain 30% increased Basic Attack Power and Strength for 4 seconds if you strike an enemy first.

items.text: New: The duration of the buff is increased by 2s if triggered by Summon Suku leap.

items.detail: - Mount your Panther Suku, gaining movement speed by decreased strafe speed. You may Leap off of Suku to deal Physical damage in the target area.

- Flip over the last enemy you hit within 1.5 seconds, Rooting, Crippling, and dealing Physical Damage to them. The damage dealt is increased by 50% based on the next attack in your Basic Attack progression.

items.lead: - Suku comes to Awilix’s aid, rushing forward dealing Physical Damage to all enemies. If hit from the side or behind, enemies are also Knocked Up.

items.text: New: Can now be fired while riding Suku.

items.lead: - Pull the closest enemy god to you that is either Knocked Up or Leaping. The target god takes Physical Damage and is Stunned when they land.

items.text: New: While the Gravity Surge buff is active, you now always gain the maximum benefit of Feather Step regardless of the next attack in your progression.
Updated various face models including Aphrodite, Achilles, and Phantom Seas Poseidon
The Assault mode has been changed! Check out the details in the Gameplay section
Thor has a new aspect! Aspect of Thunderstruck

Thunderstruck is always active; triggering it 3 times on a god heals Thor, slowing and trembling them. Warrior’s Madness grants Protections instead of Strength. Mjolnir’s Attunement no longer deals bonus return damage, and Tectonic Rift has no damage scaling.
Two new chests are now available for Classic and Cross-Gen skins:
Classic Skin Chest - Contains 8 Classic Skins
Chaos Chest - 15 dark, fiery, and supernatural skins!
New Featured Store to showcase new skins released with each patch in one convenient location!
Scoreboard QOL that allows players to read each god’s abilities by selecting their portrait.
God Page multi ability display toggling has been added.
Jump Stamps can now be seen on raised pedestals on the God Page
The Titan's Basic Attack cleave no longer hits Minotaurs
Reduced Damage Vs Minotaurs coefficient by 30%
Will now try to get close and use melee attacks against enemy Titans
Primal (Blue) Buff now grants +5 MPS and +20 CDR in this mode
Whenever a player re-rolls, their previously owned god is placed onto a team bench
Teammates can freely swap their current god with a god on the bench
You will not be able to swap to gods you do not own
You can, however, swap back to any gods you’ve rolled
Reduced respawn timer multiplier from 3.0x to 2.5x XP Level
Pushed up the overtime penalty start time from 30min to 10min (adds +1sec to respawn timer per minute)
Jump Stamps no longer visible through fog of war
The base reward for a player kill has been increased from 50 to 130
The inferior multiplier has been increased from 0.1 to 0.2
The superior multiplier has been decreased from 0.25 to 0.2
Players can now use the Runic Bomb to destroy the enemy’s base doors
Increased the duration of the Damage buff from 6 to 9 seconds when used without reviving
Increased Gold Reward of the regular bounty from 15g to 30g
Increased Gold Reward of the final bounty from 30g to 60g
On spawn, minions have two stacks of Spawn Protection
Each stack provides +25% damage reduction and +100% physical power
These stacks are represented as shield icons under their health bar
When a minion passes through a friendly tower, one stack of Spawn Protection is removed
If a friendly tower in their lane is destroyed, they will spawn with one less stack of Spawn Protection
Minions already spawned will also lose one stack
Melee attack scaling coefficient Vs Towers from 0.4 to 0.8
Ranged attack scaling coefficient Vs Towers from 0.4 to 0.6
Fire Melee attack scaling coefficient Vs Minions from 1.25 to 1.5
Fire Ranged attack scaling coefficient Vs Minions from 1.25 to 1.5
Reduced attack scaling coefficient Vs Minions from 1.0 to 0.6
(This effectively makes regular minions able to tank 1 extra Tower shot on average)
Reduced attack scaling coefficient Vs Siege Minotaurs from 1.0 to 0.7
Added a damage reduction effect when the Phoenix takes Basic Attack damage
A single hit of damage from a Basic Attack (after mitigations) is reduced if the damage is greater than 2.5% of the Phoenix's Max Health
The reduction starts at 0% when the incoming damage is equal to 2.5%, and increases as incoming damage rises
Increased initial Health on respawn from 20% to 50%
Removed the -50% Max Health penalty on respawn
Decreased Ability Damage Increase from 7.5% to 6%
Decreased Physical Penetration per stack from 0.4 to 0.3 (decreased from 20% to 15% at max stacks)
Decreased STR Scaling on initial hit from 40% to 30%
Decreased STR Scaling on Explosion from 40% to 30%
Decreased Buff Duration from 5s to 4s on both stances
Decreased Axe Stance Movement Speed buff from 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% to 8/10/12/14/16%
Decreased Base %Stats from other items from 2% to 1%
Decreased %Stats from other items per level from 0.5% to 0.4%
Decreases total stats from other items on the lamp from 12% to 9% at lvl 20
Decreased Jealousy Damage INcrease from 5/7.5/10/12.5/15% to 6/7/8/9/10%
Increased INT Scaling per tick on the Damage over Time from 15% to 17.5%
Increased Damage per tick from 20/35/50/65/80 to 25/40/55/70/85
Increased Max Damage of the travelling Typhoon from 210/270/330/390/450 to 220/285/350/415/480
Passive: Protects you from a single hard Crowd Control once every 60s. When this triggers, gain 1.5s of Crowd Control Immunity
Passive: For every 30 Intelligence, you gain 2 Basic Attack Damage and 2% Attack Speed
Passive: You gain additional Intelligence and Lifesteal scaled from missing Health. This caps at 60 Intelligence and 10% Lifesteal at 40% Health
Passive: Healing obtained from Lifesteal is increased by 10%. Your Intelligence is increased by 1.75x the amount of Lifesteal you have.
Decreased base % Health damage per tick from 1% to 0.5%
Decreased Penetration per Stack 7.5% to 6% (30% to 24% at max stacks)
Decreased Penetration per Stack 7.5% to 6% (30% to 24% at max stacks)
Decreased Cooldown of the passive trigger from 45s to 30s
Decreased True Damage on “After casting ability” trigger from 20 to 10
Increased Duration of the Healing Reduction debuff from 4s to 6s
Increased Duration of the Healing Reduction debuff from 4s to 6s
Increased Duration of the Healing Reduction debuff from 4s to 6s
Enemies hit by this have their HP shields reduced by 50%
Increased the projectile range from 8.8m to 10.5m so it matches the currently used targeter
Enemies hit by this have their HP shields reduced by 50%
Updated console cursor pings speed to be faster, similar to SMITE 1
Vulcan Lobby VFX now plays on backpack instead of ground
Global Emotes should no longer show up pixelated
Zeus ultimate VFX updated to have better visibility for airborne players, such as when Rama is aiming in his ultimate. Base Zeus and skins affected.
Fixed Ra Ascension Pass Skins having distracting bright VFX on each basic attack
Bumped up opacity on Amaterasu’s skins for her passive glow aura VFX
Improved Naga soldiers ability to target Jungle Bosses
Fixed the Fire Giant ember’s respawn timer getting cancelled if a player stood in the same location as its new spawn location
Fixed jungle waypoint assistant pointing to the wrong location on the minimap
Fixed Meditation healing other players based on the caster’s missing health and mana
Fixed an issue where he could wall run outside of his lamp bounds and become stuck
Fixed Clay Soldiers targeting Jungle Wisps
Fixed minion stealth aggro when fighting the Pyromancer
Fixed the VO ability lines on his Party Animal skin using his default voice
Fixed his weapon glow being seen from out of relevancy
Fixed Polynomicon not always proccing on his first ability
Fixed an issue with Bladed Arrow not passing through player-made walls or geometry
Fixed an issue with her Lunar Hex skin where her cape would go crazy
Fixed an issue where if two Mordred’s ulted each other near a wall, one would become stuck
Fixed an issue where she could use Vulcan’s Duel Mod in the Item store after she transformed into him
Fixed an issue on the EOML screen for Joust and Duel always showing a 5v5 layout, instead of a 1v1 or 3v3 format
Fixed an issue where the Pause UI would become hidden behind the store during pauses
Fixed an issue where the in-game Settings menu would block player movement when it was opened. This should now match SMITE 1 parity.
Fixed issues where Item Store prices were resetting in the All Items view from toggling filters
Added Tower Area Radius Structures to Conquest and Assault
Fixed an issue where Aladdin A02 was difficult and inconsistent to cancel
Readded Bloodforge to the item shop
The Purchase button will no longer disappear from the Store/Featured page if you select a skin you own.
Pinging the map while moving will no longer cause the player to stop moving
Gods on rotation should now sort to the top at the Gods page
[Draft Lobby] Other players will no longer persistently show as trade blocked on a trade popup after youI decline their trade request
Removed a ghost red dot on the Player Profile.
Added missing descriptions for recently balance changes
Fixed and issue where Meditation Relic did not work in Assault
Artemis Non-Aspect traps should now stack correctly
Put in a potential fix to address an outstanding Xbox crash
Fixed an issue where the Purchase Diamonds button wasn’t working on the Chests screen.
Put in potential fix for issue where Draft Lobby team widgets are not showing up
Fixed an issue where in certain situations Artemis Vengeful Assault was not applying correct attack speed level
Fixed an issue where rebinds of 2 individual inputs would reset when logging back in
Added a filter for 'On Rotation' to the God page
Fixed an issue where Magi's Cloak was activating from self (example: Ymir Wall rocket jump)
Fixed an issue in Assault Bench where players' initial assault choices are sometimes being added to the bench
Fixed an issue with Auto Build where starter item upgrades aren't upgrading when reaching the level requirements
Spear of Desolation and Jotunns Revenge will no longer proc on clones
Fixed a specific type of crash involving game modes
Potential fix to an issue in the draft lobby where the UI would not show teams
Fixed an issue where the HUD would not operate as expected during announcements like "Player X got a double kill"
Prophetic Cloak Reactivation: Prophetic Cloak was turned back on after the devs ironed out some unexpected behaviors.
Typhon’s Fang Disabled: Temporarily removed because buying and selling it retained its passive permanently. A fix is on the way.

content.text: With enhanced agility, refined precision, and the triumphant return of her signature lunar strikes, Awilix in SMITE 2 emerges as a swift and deadly huntress, ruling the night with unmatched prowess!
Mount Suku. Command the moonlight. And let your enemies fall beneath the silent fury of Awilix.

items.text: PC players can now cap framerate at 90 or 144 FPS. More options could be added if there’s demand—give your feedback!
A minor technical delay meant the Double Worshiper Weekend started late. To compensate, the event is extended for an extra day so everyone can level up their new gods.

items.detail: : An issue causing hidden team names in draft lobbies was fixed.

items.text: Returning as an active item featuring a stealth-reveal ability (think a “sonar ping” effect).
Successful reveals grant bonus damage and movement speed for a chase.
Perfect for countering invisible gods like Loki or Izanami.
A long-awaited feature is here: you can now move and resize HUD elements freely on PC.
Console support planned for a future update once the PC version is polished.
60+ classic music themes from past events, passes, and more are returning in a Music Chest.
Use your Legacy Gems to roll for these nostalgic themes (excluding licensed tracks).
Refinements to Conquest map visuals near towers.
Fixed a VFX skin issue with Nu Wa
Fixed a fairly common PS5 crash
Fixed some elements invalidating the HUD which we believe may solve another part of Store Overlay issues.
Thor Aspect Now Reflects the Following - Heal 5% +0.1% per level to 4% + 0.075% per level and slow 40% to 30%.
Fixed an issue where Thor Aspect was not cleansable as designed
Fixed an issue where cancelling Anubis Ability 1 would still proc poly/hydras
Fixed an issue with Typhon's Fang Passive. It will now be re-enabled.
Fixed an issue where Beads weren't preventing getting pulled from Awilix's Ultimate
Fixed an issue with Magi's Cloak where Bellona and Zeus would proc unintentionally

items.detail: : Fixed a bug where Poseidon’s Changing Tides movement speed wasn’t applying.

items.text: Flip-over mechanic no longer causes you to get stuck.
Gravity Surge no longer drops targets into walls.
Adjusted certain hit/attack timings to make her feel smoother to play.

items.detail: : A build rollback occurred to fix an Xbox update download issue. While this means redownloading for some players, the team felt it was the quickest way to restore stable play for everyone.
